recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, minimalist composition featuring two male figures in dark suits positioned on the left, set against a flat, neutral grey background with massive, lowercase sans-serif typography spanning the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-text overlap where the figures partially obscure the lower stems of the letters
Asymmetrical balance with subjects weighted to the left and negative space to the right
Contrast between the sharp, white geometric type and the soft, textured studio lighting on the subjects
coreInvariants: Full-body or three-quarter length portraits in dark formal attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the left third of the frame, standing at approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white lowercase 'w' at the top left corner acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large text on the top left, follow the word across to the right, then drop down to the subjects on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open grey space on the right half of the image creates a sense of modern isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral medium grey background providing a mid-tone canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the primary typography to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blacks and dark charcoals in the suits, with small pops of white and burgundy in the shirts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text and dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to grey, white, black, and muted skin tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' with a short, sharp crossbar

composition.scale: Extremely large, roughly 25% of total height

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; no secondary type present.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic 80s clean aesthetic with similar proportions.
Captures the geometric circularity of the 'a' and 'o'.
Modern digital equivalent with high legibility and similar x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two men in 1980s dark suits against a flat, solid medium-grey background. Position them on the left side of the frame, leaving the top and right side empty. Lighting should be soft but directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single word in large, white, lowercase geometric sans-serif across the top. Ensure the text is tightly kerned and positioned so the subjects' heads slightly overlap the bottom of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat grey without texture or gradients?
Are the subjects positioned asymmetrically to the left?
Does the text bleed or sit very close to the top edge?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'w' is not capitalized.
Verify the subjects are not centered.
Ensure the white text is perfectly legible against the grey.
Confirm the suits appear as dark silhouettes with subtle detail.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Flat Grey Backdrop + Oversized Lowercase Sans-Serif Header + Left-Weighted Asymmetry
